information.name: Monthly P&L Grid
information.description: A performant monthly P&L grid, far faster than a Power BI matrix or table: seven sections as actual, last year and variance across Jan to Dec, YTD, YTG and FY. All 315 cells are derived in the spec from 12 monthly rows. Design by Timothy Osborn.
information.author: Timothy Osborn

dataset.name: Year
dataset.description: Calendar year. One row per year and month.

dataset.name: Month Offset
dataset.description: Months from the current month: 0 this month, -1 last month. Use the minimum over the month.

dataset.name: Month Selected
dataset.description: 1 for a month to highlight, else 0. A measure that always returns 0 turns highlighting off.

dataset.name: COGS Act
dataset.description: Total cost of sales, actual, as a negative number.

dataset.name: COGS LY
dataset.description: Total cost of sales, last year, as a negative number.

dataset.name: Opex Act
dataset.description: Total operating expenses, actual, as a negative number.

dataset.name: Opex LY
dataset.description: Total operating expenses, last year, as a negative number.

description: Monthly P&L statement grid: 28 rows by 15 columns from one flat monthly query.

transform.expr: isValid(datum.MonthOffset) && isValid(datum.Year) && isValid(datum.Month) ? 12 * datum.Year + datum.Month - datum.MonthOffset : null
(datum.IncLY == null || datum.IncLY == 0) ? null : (((datum.IncAct == null ? 0 : datum.IncAct) - datum.IncLY) / datum.IncLY)
(datum.CogLY == null || datum.CogLY == 0) ? null : (((datum.CogAct == null ? 0 : datum.CogAct) - datum.CogLY) / datum.CogLY)
(datum.GPLY == null || datum.GPLY == 0) ? null : (((datum.GPAct == null ? 0 : datum.GPAct) - datum.GPLY) / datum.GPLY)
(datum.IncAct == null || datum.IncAct == 0 || datum.GPAct == null) ? null : (datum.GPAct / datum.IncAct)
(datum.IncLY == null || datum.IncLY == 0 || datum.GPLY == null) ? null : (datum.GPLY / datum.IncLY)
(datum.gm_act == null && datum.gm_ly == null) ? null : ((datum.gm_act == null ? 0 : datum.gm_act) - (datum.gm_ly == null ? 0 : datum.gm_ly))
(datum.OpxLY == null || datum.OpxLY == 0) ? null : (((datum.OpxAct == null ? 0 : datum.OpxAct) - datum.OpxLY) / datum.OpxLY)
(datum.IncAct == null || datum.IncAct == 0 || datum.OpxAct == null) ? null : (-datum.OpxAct / datum.IncAct)
(datum.IncLY == null || datum.IncLY == 0 || datum.OpxLY == null) ? null : (-datum.OpxLY / datum.IncLY)
(datum.opr_act == null && datum.opr_ly == null) ? null : ((datum.opr_act == null ? 0 : datum.opr_act) - (datum.opr_ly == null ? 0 : datum.opr_ly))
(datum.NPLY == null || datum.NPLY == 0) ? null : (((datum.NPAct == null ? 0 : datum.NPAct) - datum.NPLY) / datum.NPLY)

datum.fmt == 'pct' ? (datum.av >= 1 ? format(datum.av, '.0%') : format(datum.av, '.1%')) : currencySymbol + (datum.av >= 999950 ? format(datum.av / 1e6, ',.1f') + 'M' : datum.av >= 999.5 ? format(datum.av / 1e3, ',.1f') + 'K' : format(datum.av, ',.0f'))

fill.signal: datum.isVar && datum.value != null && datum.value != 0 ? ((datum.badUp ? -datum.value : datum.value) > 0 ? colorGood : colorBad) : textColor
